summary: 35-year-old Minnesota man broke his lower leg stepping off a 16-inch rock while backpacking the Warner Route on the South Rim, Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP, with a friend; splinted with a trekking pole and a fishing rod, but self-rescue impossible on the steep loose terrain; rangers and a paramedic spent the night in the canyon with the pair; scree evacuation the next morning; transported by ambulance to Montrose Memorial Hospital
location: Warner Route (South Rim), Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park
responding_agency: Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP rangers; Black Canyon Volunteer SAR
notes: NPS morning report dated 2014-07-11; incident Thursday 2014-07-03
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Montrose County, Colorado, United States)
